info.title: Kixikila API
info.description: API para Kixikila Digital: autenticacao JWT, gestao de grupos/ciclos, roles, pagamentos e fluxo USSD *404#. Endpoints protegidos exigem Authorization: Bearer {token}. Roles disponiveis: member, coordinator, agent, admin.
